name: Enhanced Next Up
description: Selects the Next Up episode based on the episode most recently watched instead of the highest-numbered watched episode, so returning viewers see the correct continuation point.
overview: Next Up that picks up where you actually left off, not just the highest episode you've watched.

versions.changelog: Fix: NextUp override never applied because the action filter matched the wrong controller name (route segment "Shows" instead of MVC controller name "TvShows").
